text: That is an iceberg. And I am on the Titanic.
My part is made up. Everything around me is true.
It is 11:40 at night, the 14th of April 1912.
The ship swings away. Too late. The ice scrapes along her side.
On deck, nobody runs. They call her unsinkable.
Below, the sea is coming in. She can float with four compartments flooded. At least five are open.
The wireless room calls for help. The ship that answers cannot be here before four in the morning.
Then the order comes: women and children first.
So I count the lifeboats. Twenty. Room for about half of us.
And the bow is already going down.
